newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian 88 makes Alberta natgas discovery.
newsitem.headline: Canadian 88 makes Alberta natgas discovery.

text.p: Canadian 88 Energy Corp said on Monday it made a natural gas discovery at Netook, Alberta, which was completed and on stream at a rate of five million cubic feet per day.

Canadian 88, which is in the midst of attempting to take over Morrison Petroleums Ltd in a hostile, C$652 million deal, said gas from the horizontal well was flowing into the company's Olds Crossfield gas plant in south-central Alberta.

The company said the well was centered in the north portion of a 350-square-mile 3-D seismic program being conducted by Canadian 88 in conjunction with Houston-based Western Geophysical, a division of Western Atlas Inc.
The seismic program is the largest ever to be shot on shore in Canada using 3-D techiques, Canadian 88 said.
